messages:
Maria: FYI nightly eval on the INT8 profile for llama-3-small has a weird token-collapse pattern on the summarization prompt set. Lots of truncated/looped outputs. Attaching examples below. :eyes:
Kevin: can you paste a few failing examples and the eval job id? did fp16 baseline run same set?
Maria: job id: nightly-quant-214765. Baseline fp16 looks clean. sample outputs: ```
Input: "Summarize the document about quarterly revenue"
FP16: "Revenue increased 12% quarter-over-quarter driven by…"
INT8: "Revenue revenue revenue revenue."
Another INT8: "In conclusion in conclusion in conclusion."
```
AJ: hmm that's classic collapse. Which quant recipe/profile did the job use (per-tensor vs per-channel, symmetric/asymmetric, calibr set size)?
Maria: used the default nightly profile: per-tensor asymmetric affine, 1024 calib samples, dynamic per-layer clip. Command we ran: ```
./tools/quantize.sh --model llama3-small --bits 8 --scheme asymmetric --calib 1024 --save qmodel/llama3_small_int8
```
Leo: could it be KV-cache warmup / cache eviction weirdness on the runtime? sometimes quantized keys blow attention logits. Any diff in sequence lengths between calib and eval?
Maria: good call — eval has longer tail sequences (avg 512 vs calib 128). That mismatch might explain scale underestimation on attention.
Sophia: try rerunning calib with longer sequences or use context-aware calibration. Also run eval with deterministic sampling (greedy) vs sampled to see if it's a sampling artifact. I'll spin a run if you give me the job id. :thumbsup:
CI-bot: nightly-quant-214765 completed at 2025-11-02T03:12:45Z. Artifacts: logs/214765.tar.gz, metrics.csv.
Kevin: can you paste quick metric diffs (ROUGE/Perplexity) fp16 -> int8 on the failure prompts?
Maria: quick grep from metrics.csv: "rouge1": fp16 0.43, int8 0.29; "perplexity": fp16 12.4, int8 37.1 — big regression concentrated on ~7% of prompts.
AJ: that distribution fits miscalibrated attention scales. Try per-channel quantization for attention & projection matrices only, keep rest per-tensor. Also increase calib to 5k samples and include longer contexts.
Leo: I'll run the profiling script to dump per-layer min/max on a subset: ```
python tools/profile_ranges.py --model qmodel/llama3_small_int8 --input examples/long_ctx.jsonl --out ranges.json
```
Sophia: alternative quick check: run FP8 quant run (we have nightly fp8 builds) to see if FP8 preserves range. If FP8 is fine then it's probably scale quantization resolution.
Maria: ok re-runs queued: 1) calib=5k longer contexts per-channel for attn/proj, 2) fp8 nightly compare, 3) eval with greedy. Will report back in ~2 hours. Thanks everyone.
Kevin: great — if collapse persists, add a debug hook to log topk logits before softmax for failing prompts. that often pinpoints zero-point shift.
Maria: will do. scheduling a quick triage at 11:30 if needed. :calendar:
